verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֗ה הַדָּבָ֣ר בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִינָ֖ה אָנֹכִ֜י נֹשֵׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer qî·nāh ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·śê ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Hear - this word O house of Israel this lamentation I take up against you

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹֽא־ ק֔וּם תוֹסִ֣יף נִטְּשָׁ֥ה עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֖הּ אֵ֥ין מְקִימָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·p̄ə·lāh bə·ṯū·laṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō- qūm ṯō·w·sîp̄ niṭ·ṭə·šāh ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯāh ’ên mə·qî·māh
verses.literal: Fallen is Virgin Israel never to rise again She lies abandoned on her land with no one to raise her up

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ הָעִ֛יר הַיֹּצֵ֥את אֶ֖לֶף מֵאָ֑ה תַּשְׁאִ֣יר וְהַיּוֹצֵ֥את מֵאָ֛ה עֲשָׂרָ֖ה תַּשְׁאִ֥יר לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hā·‘îr hay·yō·ṣêṯ ’e·lep̄ mê·’āh taš·’îr wə·hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ mê·’āh ‘ă·śā·rāh taš·’îr lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is what . . . the Lord GOD says The city that marches out a thousand strong will have but a hundred left and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָמַ֛ר לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דִּרְשׁ֖וּנִי וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl dir·šū·nî wiḥ·yū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel Seek Me and live

verses.original: וְאַֽל־ תִּדְרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל תָבֹ֔אוּ וְהַגִּלְגָּל֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע לֹ֣א כִּ֤י הַגִּלְגָּל֙ גָּלֹ֣ה יִגְלֶ֔ה וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה לְאָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tiḏ·rə·šū bêṯ- ’êl ṯā·ḇō·’ū wə·hag·gil·gāl lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇō·rū ū·ḇə·’êr še·ḇa‘ lō kî hag·gil·gāl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh ū·ḇêṯ- ’êl yih·yeh lə·’ā·wen
verses.literal: Do not seek vvv Bethel or go to Gilgal do not journey vvv to Beersheba . . . for Gilgal will surely go into exile . . . vvv and Bethel will come to nothing

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וִֽחְי֑וּ פֶּן־ יִצְלַ֤ח כָּאֵשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְאָכְלָ֥ה וְאֵין־ לְבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃ מְכַבֶּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: dir·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wiḥ·yū pen- yiṣ·laḥ kā·’êš bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh wə·’ên- lə·ḇêṯ- ’êl mə·ḵab·beh
verses.literal: Seek - the LORD and live or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph it will devour everything with no one vvv at Bethel to extinguish it

verses.original: הַהֹפְכִ֥ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לְלַעֲנָ֖ה הִנִּֽיחוּ׃ וּצְדָקָ֖ה לָאָ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: ha·hō·p̄ə·ḵîm miš·pāṭ lə·la·‘ă·nāh hin·nî·ḥū ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֨ה כִימָ֜ה וּכְסִ֗יל וְהֹפֵ֤ךְ צַלְמָ֔וֶת לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ הֶחְשִׁ֑יךְ וְי֖וֹם לַ֣יְלָה הַקּוֹרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־ הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ḵî·māh ū·ḵə·sîl wə·hō·p̄êḵ ṣal·mā·weṯ lab·bō·qer heḥ·šîḵ wə·yō·wm lay·lāh haq·qō·w·rê lə·mê- hay·yām way·yiš·pə·ḵêm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: He who made the Pleiades and Orion who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth the LORD is His name

verses.original: הַמַּבְלִ֥יג שֹׁ֖ד עַל־ עָ֑ז וְשֹׁ֖ד יָבֽוֹא׃ עַל־ מִבְצָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ham·maḇ·lîḡ šōḏ ‘al- ‘āz wə·šōḏ yā·ḇō·w ‘al- miḇ·ṣār
verses.literal: He flashes destruction on the strong so that fury comes upon the stronghold

verses.original: שָׂנְא֥וּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ בַשַּׁ֖עַר יְתָעֵֽבוּ׃ וְדֹבֵ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: śā·nə·’ū mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ḇaš·ša·‘ar yə·ṯā·‘ê·ḇū wə·ḏō·ḇêr tā·mîm
verses.literal: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן יַ֣עַן בּוֹשַׁסְכֶ֞ם עַל־ דָּ֗ל תִּקְח֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וּמַשְׂאַת־ בַּר֙ וְלֹא־ תֵ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑ם בָּתֵּ֥י גָזִ֛ית בְּנִיתֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָֽם׃ חֶ֣מֶד כַּרְמֵי־ נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ya·‘an bō·wō·šas·ḵem ‘al- dāl tiq·ḥū mim·men·nū ū·maś·’aṯ- bar wə·lō- ṯê·šə·ḇū ḇām bāt·tê ḡā·zîṯ bə·nî·ṯem wə·lō ṯiš·tū ’eṯ- yê·nām ḥe·meḏ kar·mê- nə·ṭa‘·tem
verses.literal: Therefore because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain you will never live in the stone houses . . . you have built you will never drink - the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted

verses.original: כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם רַבִּ֣ים חַטֹּֽאתֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים צֹרְרֵ֤י צַדִּיק֙ לֹ֣קְחֵי כֹ֔פֶר וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים הִטּֽוּ׃ בַּשַּׁ֥עַר
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ḏa‘·tî piš·‘ê·ḵem rab·bîm ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm ṣō·rə·rê ṣad·dîq lō·qə·ḥê ḵō·p̄er wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm hiṭ·ṭū baš·ša·‘ar
verses.literal: For I know [that] your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous You oppress the righteous by taking bribes {you deprive} the poor of justice in the gate

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הַמַּשְׂכִּ֛יל יִדֹּ֑ם הַהִ֖יא בָּעֵ֥ת כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ham·maś·kîl yid·dōm ha·hî bā·‘êṯ kî ‘êṯ rā·‘āh hî
verses.literal: Therefore the prudent keep silent in such times for the days are evil . . .

verses.original: דִּרְשׁוּ־ ט֥וֹב וְאַל־ רָ֖ע לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֑וּ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֛וֹת וִיהִי־ כֵ֞ן אִתְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū- ṭō·wḇ wə·’al- rā‘ lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wî·hî- ḵên ’it·tə·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem
verses.literal: Seek good not evil so that you may live And the LORD the God of Hosts will be . . . with you as you have claimed

verses.original: שִׂנְאוּ־ רָע֙ וְאֶ֣הֱבוּ ט֔וֹב וְהַצִּ֥יגוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַשַּׁ֖עַר אוּלַ֗י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת יֶֽחֱנַ֛ן שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: śin·’ū- rā‘ wə·’e·hĕ·ḇū ṭō·wḇ wə·haṣ·ṣî·ḡū miš·pāṭ ḇaš·ša·‘ar ’ū·lay Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ye·ḥĕ·nan šə·’ê·rîṯ yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: Hate evil and love good establish justice in the gate Perhaps the LORD the God of Hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י אָמַ֨ר מִסְפֵּ֔ד בְּכָל־ רְחֹב֣וֹת יֹאמְר֣וּ הוֹ־ ה֑וֹ וּבְכָל־ חוּצ֖וֹת אִכָּר֙ וְקָרְא֤וּ אֶל־ אֵ֔בֶל י֥וֹדְעֵי נֶֽהִי׃ אֶל־ וּמִסְפֵּ֖ד
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ā·mar mis·pêḏ bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ yō·mə·rū hōw- hōw ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ’ik·kār wə·qā·rə·’ū ’el- ’ê·ḇel yō·wḏ·‘ê ne·hî ’el- ū·mis·pêḏ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD the God of Hosts the Lord says There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of Alas Alas in all the streets The farmer will be summoned to mourn and the mourners . . . to wail

verses.original: מִסְפֵּ֑ד וּבְכָל־ כְּרָמִ֖ים כִּֽי־ אֶעֱבֹ֥ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֖ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mis·pêḏ ū·ḇə·ḵāl kə·rā·mîm kî- ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr bə·qir·bə·ḵā ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: There will be wailing in all the vineyards for I will pass through your midst says the LORD

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַמִּתְאַוִּ֖ים אֶת־ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה לָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה לָכֶ֛ם הוּא־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ham·miṯ·’aw·wîm ’eṯ- yō·wm Yah·weh lām·māh- zeh yō·wm Yah·weh lā·ḵem hū- ḥō·šeḵ wə·lō- ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Woe to you who long for - the Day of the LORD What . . . will the Day of the LORD be for you It [will be] darkness and not light

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר אִישׁ֙ יָנ֥וּס מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֲרִ֔י וּפְגָע֖וֹ הַדֹּ֑ב וּבָ֣א הַבַּ֔יִת וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ הַקִּ֔יר וּנְשָׁכ֖וֹ הַנָּחָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ’îš yā·nūs mip·pə·nê hā·’ă·rî ū·p̄ə·ḡā·‘ōw had·dōḇ ū·ḇā hab·ba·yiṯ wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al- haq·qîr ū·nə·šā·ḵōw han·nā·ḥāš
verses.literal: It will be like a man who flees from a lion only to encounter a bear or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall only to be bitten by a snake

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה חֹ֛שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־ א֑וֹר וְאָפֵ֖ל וְלֹא־ נֹ֥גַֽהּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- yō·wm Yah·weh ḥō·šeḵ wə·lō- ’ō·wr wə·’ā·p̄êl wə·lō- nō·ḡah lōw
verses.literal: Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light even gloom with no brightness in it

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֥אתִי מָאַ֖סְתִּי חַגֵּיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָרִ֖יחַ בְּעַצְּרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śā·nê·ṯî mā·’as·tî ḥag·gê·ḵem wə·lō ’ā·rî·aḥ bə·‘aṣ·ṣə·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: I hate I despise your feasts I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ תַּעֲלוּ־ לִ֥י עֹל֛וֹת וּמִנְחֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶרְצֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥לֶם מְרִיאֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א אַבִּֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ta·‘ă·lū- lî ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·min·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem lō ’er·ṣeh wə·še·lem mə·rî·’ê·ḵem lō ’ab·bîṭ
verses.literal: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings I will not accept them for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard

verses.original: הָסֵ֥ר מֵעָלַ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁרֶ֑יךָ לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמָֽע׃ וְזִמְרַ֥ת נְבָלֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: hā·sêr mê·‘ā·lay hă·mō·wn ši·re·ḵā lō ’eš·mā‘ wə·zim·raṯ nə·ḇā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Take away from Me the noise of your songs I will not listen to the music of your harps

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְיִגַּ֥ל כַּמַּ֖יִם וּצְדָקָ֖ה אֵיתָֽן׃ כְּנַ֥חַל
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ wə·yig·gal kam·ma·yim ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ’ê·ṯān kə·na·ḥal
verses.literal: But let justice roll on like a river and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream

verses.original: הִֽגַּשְׁתֶּם־ לִ֧י הַזְּבָחִ֨ים וּמִנְחָ֜ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַמִּדְבָּ֛ר בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hig·gaš·tem- lî haz·zə·ḇā·ḥîm ū·min·ḥāh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ḇam·miḏ·bār bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness O house of Israel

verses.original: וּנְשָׂאתֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת סִכּ֣וּת מַלְכְּכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כִּיּ֣וּן כּוֹכַב֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר צַלְמֵיכֶ֑ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śā·ṯem ’êṯ sik·kūṯ mal·kə·ḵem wə·’êṯ kî·yūn kō·w·ḵaḇ ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer ṣal·mê·ḵem ‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You have taken along - Sakkuth your king - and Kaiwan your star god - the idols you made for yourselves

verses.original: וְהִגְלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵהָ֣לְאָה לְדַמָּ֑שֶׂק אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃פ אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·hā·lə·’āh lə·ḏam·mā·śeq ’ā·mar Yah·weh šə·mōw ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore I will send you into exile - beyond Damascus says the LORD whose name [is] the God of Hosts
